day_shape: 64 items dominated by Strait of Hormuz fallout — Qatari tanker struck 23nm off Doha, IRGC threats over US assets, Caspian-route Russia-Iran drone trade — with heavy regime messaging on the 70th night of Khamenei's 'martyrdom' and Bahrain arresting 41 alleged IRGC links.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz blockade and shipping
threads.summary: A cargo ship was struck by an unidentified projectile 23 nautical miles north-east of Doha, per UKMTO, while IRGC navy threatened 'heavy attack' on US assets if oil tankers come under fire. Iran International reported IRGC-linked media calling for fees on Hormuz undersea internet cables; Defa Press claimed Western media were managing market expectations about a 'final agreement'.

threads.label: Caspian route and Russia-Iran trade
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Russia is sending Iran drone parts via the Caspian Sea to bypass the Hormuz blockade and sanctions. Jerusalem Post separately reported the Iran war is hitting food production in parts of Asia through soaring prices.

threads.label: US-Iran talks and post-war assessments
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Iran is keeping the US waiting for a response to its latest proposal, with Israel cautious over uranium enrichment and monitoring gaps. Jerusalem Post reported Israel and the US prioritised degrading nuclear weaponisation over enrichment sites, and that Israel built a secret base in Iraq's desert to support the air campaign.

threads.label: Khamenei succession messaging cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that 'Americans have no place in the Persian Gulf except at the bottom of its waters' and messaging on the 'emergence of the Islamic Republic as a great power' from Seyed Mujtaba Khamenei. Multiple IRIB items marked the 'seventieth night' of the martyred leader in Pasdaran, Pishva, Qarchak, Roudehen and Safadasht.

threads.label: IRGC armed forces messaging
threads.summary: Armed forces spokesman Brig Gen Akraminia and Cmdr Shakarchi told IRIB and Defa Press that 'the initiative is in the hands of Iran's armed forces' and detailed a claimed 'defeat of America's terrorist army' in Isfahan's Dasht Mahyar operation. Defa Press also claimed France's Charles de Gaulle carrier is 'in range' of Iran's forces, and naval aviation cmdr Adm Irani described Dolphin submarine missions in the Strait of Hormuz.

threads.label: Lebanon and Hezbollah front
threads.summary: Defa Press cited Al-Mayadeen reporting 26 Lebanese killed in Israeli strikes over 24 hours, and IRIB claimed five Israeli soldiers wounded in Hezbollah drone attacks. Jerusalem Post reported Hezbollah's Al-Qard Al-Hasan resumed operations per Al-Arabiya, and ran analyses on weakening Hezbollah grip in southern Lebanon.

threads.label: Domestic crackdowns and Bahrain arrests
threads.summary: Bahrain's Interior Ministry announced the arrest of 41 individuals it linked to the IRGC, while Defa Press carried Sheikh al-Daqaq condemning the detentions of Shia scholars. Tehran's Prosecutor charged commentators Abbas Abdi and Sadegh Zibakalam plus Etemad newspaper and ANA news agency over their published statements.

events.summary_en: Discovery of fourth Caspian seal carcass on Mazandaran shores. Mazandaran General Department of Environment: The number of Caspian seal carcasses discovered on the shores of this province has reached four. These carcasses were identified on the shores of Miankale, Nur and Nowshahr by officers of the environmental protection unit and nature volunteers. The Caspian seal is the only mammal of the Caspian Sea and is among endangered species. Citizens and fishermen can report similar observations through the 1540 system.

events.title_en: Flag of Imam Reza's luminous dome will be draped in black on his designated visiting day
events.summary_en: Flag of Imam Reza's luminous dome will be draped in black on his designated visiting day. With the arrival of 23 Dhul-Qa'dah, the anniversary of the martyrdom of Hazrat Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (peace be upon him) according to one historical account and his designated visiting day, the flag of the luminous Reza dome will change colour from green to black from the morning of Sunday, 20 Ordibehesht for two days. In this ceremony, which is held in the presence of servants of the luminous shrine of Imam Rida (peace be upon him), the green flag of the sacred dome will be lowered and a black flag of mourning will be hoisted over the golden dome of the holy shrine of Imam Rida (peace be upon him) as a sign of grief and respect for this occasion.

events.title_en: Commander of naval aviation: mission of Dolphin submarines of the army's navy in the Strait of Hormuz
events.summary_en: Commander of naval aviation: mission of Dolphin submarines of the army's navy in the Strait of Hormuz. Admiral Shahram Irani, senior spokesman of the armed forces: Light submarines built by our country, proportionate to threats, capabilities and needs in the Strait of Hormuz, are engaging the trigger and expanding and bottoming. Bottoming on the seabed at great depths in the waters of the path of power in the Strait of Hormuz waterway for long periods and interception and destruction of all types of hostile vessels are among the capabilities of the light submarines of the army's navy. These submarines are known in the everyday terminology of officers and personnel as the dolphins of the Persian Gulf. The dolphins of the Persian Gulf are demonstrating our country's maritime defence power in operations named after the martyrs of the destroyer.

events.summary_en: Amir Akraminia: Details of defeat of America's terrorist army in Isfahan/ We have surprising options for the enemy. Spokesman of the Islamic Republic of Iran's armed forces, while detailing the failure of the enemy in the Dasht Mahyar operation in Isfahan, said: If the enemy again makes a miscalculation and commits aggression against our country, it will certainly face other surprising options. None of the enemy's objectives were achieved; the political equilibrium of the system was not disrupted, rather unity and cohesion within was strengthened, which we continue to witness with the presence of people in the streets. National spirit and attention to national demands increased both from the people and from government officials, and from an internal perspective, the Islamic Republic system became stronger.

events.title_en: Sheikh Abdullah al-Daqaq's reaction to widespread suppression of Bahraini scholars
events.summary_en: Sheikh Abdullah al-Daqaq's reaction to widespread suppression of Bahraini scholars. Bahraini activist cleric condemned the unlawful arrests of religious scholars in this country by the Al Khalifa regime. We strongly condemn the Bahraini government's arbitrary detention of a number of Shia scholars. This dangerous action is a blatant violation of freedom of expression and belief and an overt assault on religious and civil rights recognised both in heavenly teachings and in international laws and treaties. We emphasise that the continuation of the policy of restricting religious freedoms and dealing with religious and intellectual figures will only lead to increased discontent and tension in society. The full responsibility for these actions and actions lies with the Al Khalifa regime.

events.title_en: Maritime incident near Doha
events.summary_en: Maritime incident near Doha. According to Reuters citing the UK Maritime Trade Operations authority, a cargo ship at a distance of 23 nautical miles north-east of Doha was hit by an 'unidentified projectile'. Based on this report, the maritime authority announced that upon receiving news of the incident, it became clear that the impact of this projectile caused a small fire on the ship, but the crew managed to extinguish the blaze. According to the statement of the aforementioned source, this incident resulted in no casualties or injuries among the ship's crew.

events.title_en: The West's false narrative to ease the global energy crisis
events.summary_en: The West's false narrative to ease the global energy crisis. The closure of the Strait of Hormuz has kept the global energy market in a state of continuous anxiety and fixed oil prices at a high level. In these circumstances, the wave of news about a 'final agreement' and 'end of crisis' rather than reflecting ground reality is assessed as an attempt by the US and Western media to manage market expectations for crude oil and reduce the economic consequences of war. In America and Europe, the rise in oil prices is not just an economic issue, but is directly transformed into a political and social crisis. Rising fuel prices, increased inflation, pressure on industries and public discontent can confront governments with serious challenges.

events.title_en: Beginning of the emergence of the Islamic Republic as a great power
events.summary_en: Beginning of the emergence of the Islamic Republic as a great power. An excerpt from a message by Ayatollah Seyed Mujtaba Khamenei, the Supreme Leader of the Revolution: Today the beginning of the emergence of the Islamic Republic as a great power and the placement of arrogance in the path of weakness has become apparent before all eyes. This is undoubtedly a divine blessing that comes from the blood of our martyred leader and other crimson-shrouded martyrs and wronged compatriots and wilted flowers of the Minab tree school, and following the supplications and entreaties of the nation's members to God's court and their committed presence in battlefields, neighbourhoods and mosques, and because of the selfless, ungrudging and sincere sacrifices of religion-devoted fighters in the Sepah and army and Basij and soldiers of faith.

events.title_en: Americans have no place in the Persian Gulf except at the bottom of its waters
events.summary_en: By God's will and power, the future of the Persian Gulf region will be bright, a future without America and in service of the progress, comfort and welfare of its peoples. We are bound by a common fate with our neighbours in the Persian Gulf and the Sea of Oman, and foreigners who covet mischief from thousands of kilometres away have no place there except at the bottom of its waters. And the chain of this victory, which by the grace of the Almighty and through the calculations and strategies of Iranian resistance and strategy has been achieved, will be the herald of a new order in the region and the world. Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Leader of the Islamic Revolution
